name: ever-gauzy
description: Ever® Gauzy™ - Open Business Management Platform (ERP/CRM/HRM/ATS/PM) - https://gauzy.co
one_liner: A free, all-in-one business management platform that combines a CRM, payroll/HR, hiring, and project management into one system, instead of paying for five separate SaaS subscriptions.
buyer: A small agency or consultancy owner who wants one tool for clients, staff, hiring, and projects but can't afford Salesforce-plus-BambooHR-plus-Asana pricing.
business_use_cases: A small consultancy runs its entire client, payroll, and project operation on a self-hosted instance instead of five paid SaaS tools.
An IT services company hosts it for small-business clients as a managed, affordable Bitrix24 alternative.
An industry-specific reseller customizes it for a niche (e.g. recruiting agencies) and resells the tailored version.

money_ideas.idea: Run a hosted multi-tenant SaaS version and undercut established all-in-one business platforms on price.
Offer one-off implementation and customization services for a specific industry vertical.

steal_this: Stand up a hosted version this weekend and sell it to a few local agencies as a '$29/month replaces your five SaaS subscriptions' offer.
